releaseNotes: v8.14.2: Universal EPUB Cover Engine & Architecture Overhaul: 1) Universal EPUB Cover Architecture: fixes undefined cover mime types, eliminates duplicate manifest entries (id=cover-image), and injects standard EPUB 2/3 <guide> and <nav epub:type="landmarks"> for universal compatibility across Kindle Send-to-Kindle, Apple Books, Kobo, and Moon+ Reader; 2) Dynamic SVG Typography Cover: automatically generates high-res vector typography book covers for web novels and documents lacking cover art; 3) Cover Extraction on Ingestion: parses uploaded EPUBs, extracts cover art, and preserves original covers across translation workflows; 4) Cover Preview & Uploader: 1-click 'Add / Change Cover' tool in Translation Complete card.
